title: Bring a component fix to every affected service
trigger: A fix supersedes a component digest or a runtime version.
result: Every affected service is regenerated with the fix before the fail date.
notes: Decided by the Product owner on 2026-11-02 (ST-Q03, option A). The clock of ST-BO04 starts when the platform engineer records the supersession (step 1). Its first part stops when the sweep names every affected service (step 3). Its second part counts the affected services that complete step 4 before the fail date.
